name: Engie Brasil Energia S.A.
summary: Engie Brasil Energia S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the generation, commercialization, trading, and transmission activities in Brazil. The company also engages in the gas transportation business. As of December 31, 2025, it operates a generating park of 12,384.5 MW comprising 133 plants, including 13 hydroelectric plants and 120 complementary plants, as well as one biomass plant, 88 wind plant, two hydroelectric plants, and 29 solar plants. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Florianópolis, Brazil. Engie Brasil Energia S.A. is a subsidiary of ENGIE Brasil Participações Ltda.
